> @copilot 事例中所有组件都显示 loading grid

Fixed in commit fa59cee. The issue was that all examples were using `data: [...]` instead of `staticData: [...]`. 

ObjectGrid expects inline data to be provided via the `staticData` property (legacy format) or as a proper ViewData object: `data: { provider: 'value', items: [...] }`. 

Changed all 16 instances from `data:` to `staticData:` to use the supported legacy format. The components should now render the data properly instead of showing the loading state.

> @copilot Application error: a client-side exception has occurred while loading objectui-site-7vur3y8sn-object-stack.vercel.app (see the browser console for more information

Fixed in commit dfd1055. The client-side exception was caused by incorrect quote escaping in JSX object literals. Changed `"Monitor 27\""` to `'Monitor 27"'` in three places (lines 129, 241, and 578). In MDX/JSX, when inside a JavaScript object literal, escaped quotes (`\"`) cause syntax errors. Using single quotes for the outer string allows the double-quote character to be used inside without escaping.
